visible_evidence.consonants: From right to left: mem, qof, lamed, vav, tav.

upper_dots.description: Small round grey dot above and left of qof roof, just right of lamed: holam. Lighter than the second upper dot; moderately confident.
Clear dark dot directly above short vav between lamed and tav: holam on vav.

visible_evidence.other_marks: Hiriq below mem. Pale distinct dot inside upper bowl of qof consistent with dagesh. Lamed ascender is a stroke, not another dot. No other upper marks securely visible.
visible_evidence.uncertainty: Qof holam and internal dagesh are lighter grey than strongest ink, but placement and compact shape favor printed pointing over random blemishes.
